title: Electricity network product catalogue, version 1
sourceDescription: A first coverage slice for a distribution network operator, drafted from public vendor product pages on 21 November 2026 for review. Every claim is a dated statement from the vendor's own page and is not yet signed; nothing here is published until a named reviewer signs each claim. Coverage is deliberately a first slice: absence of a product is not a judgement that the capability does not matter.

The vendor describes complaint and feedback handling as part of customer service.
